posts.body:
SHERATON AL MARJAN — REVISED COLLECTION
Atara Development | Al Marjan Island, Ras Al Khaimah

A material update, not a first launch: the revised collection reported on 17 September comprises 168 fully furnished beachfront homes — 97 one-bedroom and 71 two-bedroom apartments.

Developer handover target: Q3 2028.
Starting price, payment plan and booking terms for this release: not reliably confirmed; the developer's pages conflict.

Why it matters: revised branded beachfront inventory worth monitoring once the commercial terms are reconciled.
Confidence: high on identity and unit mix; commercial terms unresolved.

SHAHRUKHZ 2 RESIDENCES — PRELAUNCH WATCH
Danube Properties | Dubai Maritime City

BROKER INTELLIGENCE — not yet officially confirmed.
Brokers are marketing a new residential tower; one brokerage reports EOIs open and expects a formal launch in October 2026.

Unit mix, starting price, payment plan, EOI amount and handover: not confirmed.
This is separate from the original Shahrukhz office tower on Sheikh Zayed Road — its terms must not be carried over.

Why it matters: an early waterfront residential lead before the full sales pack is available.
Confidence: medium on identity/location; timing and EOI remain broker-reported.
